compiled_state.description:
Same class as [rebar:a371-fb42-32c5-48bd] (an `importorskip`-masked test that is broken the
moment its extra IS installed). Found while running the full unit suite with the `[ui]` extra
installed to verify a371's fix.

`tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py:147`
`test_rerun_502_body_has_no_exception_detail` builds a fake request as:

    req = types.SimpleNamespace(
        app=types.SimpleNamespace(state=types.SimpleNamespace(config=cfg)),
        query_params={"token": "tok", "change": "12345"},
    )
    resp = asyncio.run(rerun(req))

`src/rebar/review_bot/app.py:101` reads `request.headers.get(TOKEN_HEADER, "").strip()`, and the
fake has no `headers`, so the test dies with:

    AttributeError: 'types.SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute 'headers'

Reproduced deterministically at origin/main (c89a2ddcc4), py3.12, with `--extra ui` installed
(which pulls fastapi):

    pytest tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py -q -p no:randomly
      -> 1 failed, 54 passed

Line 148 is `pytest.importorskip("fastapi")  # the reviewbot extra; absent in the lean CI
suite`, so the lean CI suite skips it and the breakage is invisible. As with a371, the test
reads as covering the `/rerun` 502-body containment barrier while providing no coverage in any
environment where the extra is present.

Presumably the fake request stopped matching `app.rerun` when header-token auth was added to
that handler; the fake needs a `headers` mapping (and whatever else the current handler reads).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_path_injection_guards.py` passes with the reviewbot/ui extra
      installed
- [ ] The test still asserts the same containment barrier (502 body carries no exception or
      stack-trace detail) -- do not weaken it to make it pass
- [ ] Sweep the other `importorskip`-guarded tests for the same rot, since none of them run in
      the lean CI suite
